relationships.subject: Long exon47
relationships.evidence_quote: there was only a significant effect of the long exon47 to increase trafficking to the cell surface

relationships.subject: Rbfox2
relationships.evidence_quote: The mechanism controlling insertion of exon18a was found to involve the RNA binding protein Rbfox2, which suppressed exon18a inclusion.

key_findings: Long exon47 increases CaV2.2 cell-surface expression about 4-fold independently of exon18a, whereas exon18a increases current amplitude only with long exon47.
Rs2278973 SNP variants in short exon47 did not change CaV2.2 function or expression.
